purpose: Candidate treatment families to add or normalize in the Supabase treatments table after review.
notes: This file is not the production database. It is a reviewed staging layer between raw price evidence and Supabase seed data.
Price ranges are observed public/event price signals from user-provided clinic images, not guaranteed market averages.
Rows with limited or ambiguous image text should stay in review before becoming user-facing baseline prices.
